title: Chapter 954 Going East
content:
Chapter 954 Going East

Han Xin's words were just blurted out by the young man's head, and Zhang Cang didn't take them seriously.

Xianyang Palace is still the center of the empire, but the throne is empty, with only the Emperor's Sword hanging. It is said that when the regent holds a court meeting, he has to kneel down on the throne to talk to the ministers. Everyone salutes, and he has to bow in return while working. The area is in the side hall.

The working hours set by the regent for himself were based on Qin's twelve o'clock. When Mo Shi (9 o'clock to 11 o'clock) just arrived, he came to Xianyang Palace to work on time, and left at the beginning of dusk (21 o'clock to 23 o'clock). He originally wanted to set seven He takes a break from bathing every day, but because everyone else bathes every ten days, it is difficult for the black husband to have special privileges, so he can only do this...

Now, Heifu has become 999

"No wonder the First Emperor died young..." Heifu understood immediately. He was now suffering from feelings even more bitterly than a programmer, let alone Zulong who stayed up until early morning every day.

Later, Shu Suntong came to welcome Han Xin in, and went to the side hall to meet the regent. Along the way, he talked about the "etiquette" that he should pay attention to later.

"Now that the regent has become the Grand Master and is respected as the Duke of Xia, he has to pay attention to some necessary etiquette since he was still the Marquis of Che in the past. The Marquis of Han remembered it when he met the concubine. When he first saw the regent, he looked in front of him and frowned... …”

"What does Rong Mi frown mean?" Although Han Xin is a genius in military art, he is culturally semi-literate and was confused.

"Just don't laugh, you have to be solemn."

Shusun Tong was used to old and rough generals like Han Xin. Who knows how many rude things these people did when they entered Xianyang Palace. For example, an Anlu army entered Xianyang Palace and openly attacked the feet of the twelve golden men. Engraving, triumphant. As for the few days ago, at the ceremony held by Mr. Hei in honor of Duke Xia, there were countless people who drank and competed for merit, drunkenly or yelled indiscriminately, drew their swords and struck pillars.

The Qin Dynasty seems to have no king, but in fact it has one. It has not yet become a land outside the law. Laws, dignity, and etiquette must be restored one by one, so the regent asked Shusun Tong to set up some simple etiquette to adapt to this unique " "The relationship between king and minister" means that superiors and subordinates are superior and inferior, but it doesn't have to be too much.

"After entering the palace, you can just walk forward and bow twice. There is no need to bow down. Because the Marquis of Han is the Marquis of Guannei and a general, the regent will also bow to him in return, but the Marquis of Han must wait until the regent is seated before speaking. When talking, you should look at him at the beginning After speaking, the regent's face moves downwards. When he is not speaking, he should look at the regent's knees..."

Han Xin was stunned by the phone call, and he couldn't help complaining: "The regent is just a fake emperor, and etiquette is so troublesome. If he becomes a real emperor in the future, it will be okay..."

This almost choked Shusun Tong to death. This young man was too bold. Can he say this?

Han Xin didn't take it seriously. He always felt that others had to do this, but he had made great contributions and didn't have to do this. He asked: "I used to be called Junhou, how should I be called now?"

"Regent, Grand Master or Duke Xia, of course..." Shusun Tong reminded Han Xin: "The regent especially likes to be called 'Lord' by the old ministry!"

With such warning, the two of them also went to the side hall. Shusun Tong was about to announce loudly, but Han Xin forgot all his words and only handed the sword to Lang Wei. He strode up rudely and shouted even louder:

"Father Zhong!"

…

Hei Fu didn't know what he was thinking, but he still treated Han Xin like his nephew, asked him to sit down, and asked:

"Didn't you go home?"

Han Xin's eyes did not stare at Heifu's knee that had been hit by an arrow as Shusun Tong warned. Instead, he first looked at the beautiful decorations in the palace, and then looked at Heifu's knee rudely. face, and said with a silly smile:

"No, I just came back. I got off my horse and went straight to the palace. It's very convenient to come to Beishan from the straight road."

Hei Fu inevitably said something to him: "Your wife has just arrived in Xianyang, so she should go back and have a look first."

He showed a meaningful smile again: "You don't have a brother, just take advantage of your youth and have a child sooner."

In terms of life, Heifu encourages everyone to 669. The population lost in these years of war must be made up within ten years. No matter what the conditions are, if you have the conditions, you must contribute to the country...

Wei Yang is the best among them. Hei Fu shook his head helplessly:

"Brother, your wife now has six children."

He never expected that it was Wei Yang who opened up the harem. Hei Fu felt that he had seen the wrong person. His nephew was an honest and kind person when he was young. Who taught him bad things?

In addition, the situation in the southeast was worse than Heifu expected. In August, Anpu of Danyang County attacked Huainan and was defeated by Yingbu. This guy seemed to be quite capable of fighting. Fortunately, although Anpu lost his troops, he was defeated by his brother Wei Jing. , and with the support of his nephew Wei Yang, they successfully evacuated to Hengshan County.

A victory in the battle boosted the morale of the Chu army. It happened that Xiang Yu had been running around for two months and returned to the Chu land with a few soldiers. Relying on the attack of chariots and cavalry, he defeated one of Wu Rui's men who crossed over to the East China Sea. He was always cautious and gave up the capture. The land was withdrawn to Jiangdong.

Fortunately, there was a big river blocking it, and the Weiyang tower and ships were crossing the river, so the Chu army could not get through.

But in any case, Heifu's plan to use Jiangdong to annex Huainan was in vain. The only advantage was that the Chu people were exhausted and their vitality was severely damaged. The boy Weiyang imitated himself and almost cut off all the rice in the southern part of the East China Sea. This In winter, the Chu people in Huainan may starve.

But Heifu was not satisfied with this. Since the situation in the southeast failed to open up, he had to consider other directions.

This is also the reason why he brought Han Xin back.

"How is the situation in Shangjun?" Heifu asked.

"It has been decided that the Huns have evacuated Henan and the border fortress of Shangjun. Although Maodu occupied Beijia and Yunzhong, most of the people in the new Qinzhong have evacuated to Henan and were taken over by Zhang Taipu. There are occasional Huns scouts in Shangjun. , but they were all repelled by Bai Zhaiqi."

"A letter from Zhang Han said that at least 50,000 people in Xinqin were robbed and tens of thousands more were displaced."

Heifu's heart aches and bleeds. He knows that those abducted compatriots will suffer torture worse than death. Can he rescue them? And if the Huns cannot be wiped out in one fell swoop, how strong can they be in ten or twenty years by using the captive population and the recaptured pasture?

Heifu didn't want the civil war in the Central Plains to turn into a steppe empire that would become a nightmare for the Han Dynasty for hundreds of years...

However, in this new Qinzhong defense battle, two newcomers performed outstandingly, leading the immigrant garrison to repel the Xiongnu in Henan.

One was his old subordinate Guanying, and the other's name seemed familiar to Heifu. His name was Zhou Bo. After checking, he was from Peixian County, Sishui County. This made Heifu very happy.

Zhou Bo was promoted to Lord of Five Hundred, and Guan Ying received a reward and was transferred to Xianyang as a cavalry commander. Qiang Hua and Fu Zhi, Heifu's old subordinates, were promoted to cavalry captains. In the next period of time, Heifu plans to train chariots and cavalry, Qin's dominant arms, so that they can be put to good use when the war resumes!

Speaking of cavalry, Heifu also remembered the annoying group of buildings that Han Xin had written to report.

At that time, Heifu asked Han Xin to promise Loufanren the land in the north of Saibei and draw a big cake in exchange for three thousand of their cavalry. Loufan County, Yanmen County, where Loufanren was located, was adjacent to Juzhusai and Yanmenguan, and Waizhuangdai Beizhi The vassal guard is the key to consolidating Taiyuan. It is a battleground for military strategists. If it obtains this place, it will not only be able to separate Zhao and Dai in one fell swoop, but also cooperate with the army to attack Taiyuan southward at the right time...

"Ren Lou has broken his promise..."

Han Xin became angry when he mentioned this matter. Those people in the building were selling the same thing to many people. While asking here, he also sold it to Zhao and the agent at the same price. Finally, before Han Xin gave a reply, he went to the willing company first. Zhao Guo spent a lot of money.

"Zhao General Li Zuoche is the grandson of Li Mu. He has lived in Daibei for many years. He is well aware of Lou Fan's riding skills, so he hired Lou Fanren first at the cost of five hundred catties of gold."

Shangjun is close to Taiyuan County. Taiyuan controls the mountains and rivers and sits on the back of the world. It is a battleground in ancient and modern times. It was once called the "Zhao Kingdom". Li Zuoche gathered two-thirds of Zhao's soldiers. Forty thousand people were stationed in Taiyuan County to guard against Han Xin.

Heifu smiled and said: "Ignorant Rong Di is so smart that he was misled by his cleverness. Lou Fan will regret it. From now on, I will never use gold or land to buy half of Lou Fan for my own use."

"But let him sacrifice his whole family and livestock to bribe Qin, so as not to be completely destroyed!"

He immediately asked Han Xin:

"How is Li Zuoche?"

Han Xin became solemn and said: "Li Zuoche is indeed the grandson of Li Mu. He is proficient in the art of war and knows people well. He knows that if our army wants to harm Zhao, it must start from the Taiyuan. After all, the Zhao State lost the pillar state of Taiyuan back then, and then gradually to destruction. He sent troops to guard key crossings, hired Lou Fan first, and allied with the Congress of Representatives to avoid the superiority of the north..."

"It's such an old story." Hei Fu disagreed: "Back then, Li Mu was the only pillar of the Zhao Kingdom, and now, his grandson has repeated this scene."

I just don’t know that the current King of Zhao “trusted” Li Mu just like King Zhao did in the past. Does he trust Li Zuoche, who is in charge of the Zhao army and has a high reputation?

If you don't try it, how will you know?

Han Xin did not think about this, but after analyzing the strength of Zhao Jun, he said: "I have sent scouts to test, Zhao Jun responded quickly, and the chance of successfully crossing the river is not high. Although our army can concentrate more troops in the north, However, it takes more than a month to transport grain from Guanzhong to Shangjun, and the losses are too great, so it is not suitable to launch an attack on Taiyuan and Zhao from Shangjun..."

Heifu tapped his fingers on the table. The inside was already in place and he had to start shaking:

"Then if I want to go east, who should start?"

Han Xin said: "The enemy is the weakest, the marching supplies are the most convenient, and the gains after the war are the greatest."

"Your thoughts are the same as Xiao He's."

Heifu said: "The internal history of millet management believes that after the autumn harvest, although the grain treasury is full again, it must be used sparingly. The convenience of grain transportation should be the first priority in the use of troops. Whoever is closest to Guanzhong is worthy of attacking first."

"That's right."

Han Xin said: "The subordinates also believe that we should take advantage of Chu and Zhao to take care of their own homes, defeat the weakest Wei State first, and seize the east of Hedong! Then sweep Taiyuan and Shangdang, occupy the rivers and mountains, and Dongxiang to control the Central Plains!"
